title: Head of Process Management (f/m/d)
description:
You will build the central process management function for three plants.

What you'll do
- Lead a team of eight process managers
- Own the process landscape and the improvement programme
- Report to the executive board

What you bring
- At least ten years of experience in process management, five of them in a leadership role
- Six Sigma Black Belt
- Very good German and English skills
